achievement.elite_appetite.description: Defeat multiple elites before the second-floor boss. The safest road was right there, ignored as usual.
achievement.elite_appetite.goal: Defeat at least 2 elites before clearing the second floor.

achievement.careful_archive.description: Clear the second floor without taking too much total damage. Restraint, the rarest resource.

achievement.three_bad_lessons.descriptio: Lose three runs. Education has many formats; this is the blunt one.
